en: Wailord 162/159 at £16.20 delivered left less than £6 for grading and selling costs after a 10% cut to the checked PSA 9 sale.
Raw Drowzee 210/198 was listed at £92.21 delivered. The same printing was available in PSA 9 for £62.69 delivered.
ja: Japanese 151 Pikachu 173/165 at £22.69 delivered left less than £18 for grading and selling costs after a 10% cut to the checked PSA 9 sale.
Seller photos showed a Raw Munkidori and an Ace 10 Flygon. Both listing titles included PSA 10.
